a missguided mess
Apr 2026 • Family
OUCH.

This was a extremely expensive misguided fiasco.

A total disaster.

The kitchen is trying so hard to be clever, they're forgetting about flavor.

They're serving up so many competing flavors on every plate that the core ingredient gets lost every time. The flavor of the oyster, the scallop, the tartar (etc) just gets lost and overpowered.

The focus is on whimsy - and presentation - and that part of the meal was excellent - but, without good tasting food - useless.

Service was extremely friendly - but a bit awkward and amateurish at times, and the pace of the multi course meal was uneven.

I can not recommend a meal here.

Written April 2, 2026
The Temptation
Dear Guest,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are sincerely sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.

However, we are surprised by your feedback regarding the balance of our flavors. At The Temptation, our cuisine is a celebration of French gastronomy, where each ingredient is meticulously selected for its quality. Contrary to popular belief, our signature lies precisely in the mastery of flavor.

Our chef and his team work with precision to ensure that visual flair is never an artifice, but rather a setting that enhances the product. Every flavor combination, however bold, is designed to elevate the main ingredient (whether it be our oysters or scallops) and not overshadow it.

We have nonetheless taken note of your comments regarding the pace of service and the coordination of our team, as we are always striving to perfect the overall experience.

We hope you will give us the opportunity to rediscover our world with you on a future visit, to demonstrate that taste remains, and will always remain, our top priority in Da Nang.

Best regards,
The Temptation Team Management
